definition: Zvi Mowshowitz is an American writer and member of the rationalist community who primarily discusses new developments in artificial intelligence.
details: He is a former competitive Magic: The Gathering player and was CEO of MetaMed.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. That shared ruler is Zvi Mowshowitz.
